system.description:
You ingest a vial of poison, and exhale it as a thick cloud of smoke of a color of your choice. Select a point you can see within range as a 20-foot radius cloud of poisonous mist fills the area, even bending around corners.

Creatures within the mist has their vision obscured and cannot see more than 5 feet away. Creatures outside the mist cannot visually discern between creatures within it without a special sense, only being able to see vague shadowing outlines. The mist lasts for the Duration and when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save a creature that needs to breathe takes 2d10 poison damage and gains 1 rank of Envenomed or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails their save by 5 or more begins to reeling and vomiting, losing the ability to take an Action until the end of their next turn.

A light wind disperses the cloud after 2 rounds. A strong wind disperses it after 1 round.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10.
